Share the platform's persistence contracts and user-aware data behaviour without rebuilding the same database plumbing in every domain.

Why Data belongs in the platform

Data access becomes expensive when each package invents its own context conventions, query filters and operational tooling. cCoder.Data centralises that foundation so domain packages can focus on their business rules while retaining a consistent approach to persistence.

What consumers gain

  • The shared cCoder data-access package.
  • Core data context and user-aware query behaviour.
  • A tested local tooling application for authenticated entity inspection.

A boundary that keeps paying for itself

The package supplies reusable persistence infrastructure; individual domains still own their models, rules and public operations. That distinction keeps shared mechanics from becoming a shared business layer.

Adopt the capability, not its internal complexity

Add the package at the application composition boundary, configure the providers or infrastructure it requires and consume its service contracts through dependency injection. The package keeps its implementation and operational concerns together, while the consuming code remains focused on its own business purpose.
